ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85% high-intensity (white/light grey) interior surface relative to 15% low-intensity (black) peripheral margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity black band along the trailing edge and lateral tips; focal dark clusters at the basal notch intersection; extensive micro-mottling of high-intensity white-on-grey across both central lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with an estimated pixel-based interior angle of 95-100 degrees; vertical depth approximately 12% of total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the trailing edge; higher frequency and pixel-amplitude of peaks at the distal lateral tips compared to the medial sections near the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve fitted to the trailing edge of both lobes, terminating in pointed tips with a sharp concave transition at the central notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense distribution of small, roughly circular high-contrast white pixel clusters across the entire visible ventral surface, representing concentrated scarring.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized clusters of high-intensity, textured protrusions (barnacle colonization) visible on the extreme right distal tip of the fluke.
other_distinctive_markers: Composite image format containing temporal comparison data (labeled 2010 and 2003) and a separate crop of the dorsal fin profile.
